lucide -> SemanticIcon mapping (web L3 + every usage site): Gauge (web title icon L152 text-neon-green, and the Current L78 / Phases L90 / Efficiency L104 stat icons) -> 'speedCircle' (gauge/dial glyph); the title Gauge's text-neon-green tint collapses to speedCircle's fixed intrinsic tone — the same color-tint -> semantic-icon collapse the ChargeHistory port set (text-neon-green BarChart3 -> analytics). Zap (Voltage stat icon L72) -> 'bolt'. BatteryCharging (Power stat icon L84, and the compact big readout icon L129) -> 'batteryCharging'; the web compact icon's `animate-pulse` (L129) is dropped — RN has no CSS keyframe animation, consistent with the other widget ports dropping framer/CSS motion. Plug (not-charging empty-state icon L139/L187) -> 'charger'. All icons are decorative (the web icons carry no aria-label; the surrounding label/title/message conveys meaning). Title/stat icons use size='sm' (web h-3.5 w-3.5); the compact + empty icons use size='md' (web h-5 w-5).

fmtNumber/fmtInt (web L8) ported inline mirroring web numberFormat.ts: safeNumber guard + safeNumber(v).toLocaleString(locale,{min/maxFractionDigits:decimals}) with a try/catch 'en-US' fallback; fmtInt(v)=fmtNumber(v,0). Web fmtNumber/fmtInt read a module-global precision+locale set by useSettings, but every call in this widget passes an explicit decimal count (0 or 1) so precision is irrelevant, and the global locale defaults to 'en-US' until settings load — the inline default locale 'en-US' reproduces that default exactly. No unit conversion is added: charger_power_w is read as SI and displayed with the literal 'kW' label/1-decimal exactly as the web does (web L45/L82-83 and L131), preserving parity (the web widget itself performs no Wh->kWh conversion, so introducing one would BREAK behavioural parity).

Component signature L15 export default function ChargingTelemetryWidget({ vehicleId, size }: WidgetProps) preserved one-for-one. L16 useTranslation('dashboard') -> useNativeTranslation() (namespaceless shim). L17 const { data: vehicles } = useVehicles() preserved. L25 isCompact = size.cols <= 1 and L26 isWide = size.cols >= 4 preserved. L28 isCharging = data?.charging_state === 'Charging' preserved. L31-32 powerHistoryRef = useRef<number[]>([]) and lastTsRef = useRef<string|null>(null) preserved with identical names. L34-41 the during-render rolling-buffer mutation is ported verbatim: if (data && data.ts !== lastTsRef.current) { lastTsRef.current = data.ts; const pw = data.charger_power_w ?? 0; powerHistoryRef.current = [...powerHistoryRef.current.slice(-(MAX_POWER_HISTORY - 1)), pw]; } with MAX_POWER_HISTORY=30 (L13). Mutating a ref during render is valid in both React DOM and React Native, so the behaviour is identical.

L43-46 voltage = data?.charger_voltage ?? 0; current = data?.charger_actual_current ?? 0; power = data?.charger_power_w ?? 0; phases = data?.charger_phases ?? 0 — preserved verbatim (SI fields read directly from the ported native ChargingTelemetry interface; no Mi/Mph/Kwh suffix introduced). L56-63 efficiency useMemo ported verbatim incl. the theoreticalPower=(pilot*voltage*(phases>0?phases:1))/1000 formula, the pilot<=0||voltage<=0 and theoreticalPower<=0 null guards, and Math.min(100,(power/theoreticalPower)*100); dep [data,isCharging,voltage,phases,power].

coreStats useMemo L65-93 ported verbatim as StatGridItem[]: returns [] when !isCharging; else four items — Voltage {value: fmtNumber(voltage,0), unit:'V', icon: Zap->bolt}, Current {fmtNumber(current,0), 'A', Gauge->speedCircle}, Power {fmtNumber(power,1), 'kW', BatteryCharging->batteryCharging, valueColor:'text-emerald-300'->EMERALD_300 '#6ee7b7'}, Phases {phases>0?fmtInt(phases):'—', Gauge->speedCircle}; dep [isCharging,voltage,current,power,phases,t]. The 'V'/'A'/'kW' unit literals, the fmtNumber decimal counts (0/0/1) and the em-dash fallback are preserved. wideStats useMemo L96-108 ported verbatim: [] when !isCharging||!isWide; pushes an Efficiency {fmtNumber(efficiency,0), '%', Gauge->speedCircle} only when efficiency!=null; dep [isCharging,isWide,efficiency,t]. allStats useMemo L110-113 = isWide ? [...coreStats,...wideStats] : coreStats; dep [isWide,coreStats,wideStats]. valueColor note: web stored the Tailwind class 'text-emerald-300' here; native stores the resolved color '#6ee7b7' (RN has no Tailwind) and StatGridCell applies it as the value text color, preserving the green Power readout.

Inlined native WidgetStatGrid reproduces the web ./shared/WidgetStatGrid contract: stats.length===0 -> a 'No stats available' muted caption (web EmptyState message L45; structurally dead here since coreStats always has 4 items when isCharging); resolvedCols = compact ? 1 : cols ?? autoCols(stats.length) with autoCols (count%3->3, count%4->4, else 2) ported verbatim; each stat -> a StatGridCell (surfaceRaised bordered card: muted semibold caption label + optional top-right icon, a title-size bold value with the optional valueColor override + optional muted-caption unit, and the optional trend row driven by ported trendColor/trendArrow). The web @container grid-cols-2 / grid-cols-2 @sm:grid-cols-4 column table (with @xs/@sm relaxation) collapses to a flexDirection:'row' flexWrap:'wrap' container whose cells share an even flexBasis (100/cols - 6 %) + flexGrow:1 — RN has no container queries, so the per-cols column count is honoured via flex-basis instead. The `compact` prop + trend rendering are ported for fidelity though this widget exercises neither (it always passes cols and never sets trend).

Inlined native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell subset this widget exercises (web WidgetShell.tsx): loading -> a Skeleton placeholder View (accessibilityRole progressbar); error -> the ported QueryError(new Error(error)) in a centred padded View (this widget DOES pass error, so the branch is live); titled header = icon + uppercase 11px muted title + DataFreshness; title-less compact = overlay DataFreshness dot; the L59-80 pulse-on-change useEffect/useState is ported verbatim with a green glow shadow. The unused query/help/widgetId/dashboardId/actions/noPadding props are omitted. Inlined native Badge maps the web variant (info/success/warning/danger/neutral) + size (sm/md/lg) Tailwind classes to the native dark-theme token palette + padding/font-size; only warning + neutral are exercised. NotChargingEmpty mirrors the web EmptyState icon+message (no title) with py-4 spacing.

State/prop/ref names (vehicleId, size, vehicles, id, data/isLoading/error/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch, isCompact, isWide, isCharging, powerHistoryRef, lastTsRef, voltage/current/power/phases, chargerType, efficiency, coreStats, wideStats, allStats), API queries ('/charging-telemetry/latest?vehicle_id=<id>' + '/vehicles' via the ported hooks), the 5s refetch interval, the i18n keys (widget.chargingTelemetry.title/voltage/current/power/phases/efficiency/charger/notCharging), MAX_POWER_HISTORY=30, the size.cols<=1 / >=4 breakpoints, the AC/DC + efficiency heuristics, and the Sparkline data/color/height are all preserved. No SI unit-suffixed field is added — charger_power_w/charger_voltage/charger_actual_current/charger_pilot_current are read as SI from the existing ported ChargingTelemetry interface and rendered exactly as the web does. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web @/ UI imports remain — only react, react-native primitives (StyleSheet/View/DimensionValue), the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText + theme tokens, and the ported parity Sparkline/useVehicles/useChargingTelemetryLatest/DataFreshness/QueryError.
